# Procolor Film Academy reviews

> Procolor Film Academy (PFA) is a training academy in Sector 35C, Chandigarh, where students learn photography, cinematography, video editing and smartphone content creation through hands-on, practical courses. Students rate it 4.9 on Google, and this page reproduces those reviews word for word.

This is the official reviews page of Procolor Film Academy (PFA). It reproduces 164 written Google reviews and 17 star-only ratings word for word, copied on 11 November 2026, including critical ones. The originals are on Google.

## Courses (Sector 35C, Chandigarh)
- Diploma in Photography: 2 months
- Diploma in Cinematography: 2 months
- Master Video Editing: 1 month
- Creator Lab (From Phone to Feed in 3 Weeks): 3 weeks, first batch starts 16 November 2026 (new, no reviews yet)

## Reviews summary
- Google rating: 4.9 (181 ratings copied; 169 five-star, 8 four-star, 1 three-star, 3 one-star)
- Written reviews mentioning photography: 109; cinematography: 60; video editing: 19
- Written reviews naming Gagan Chopra: 73; Durgesh Remje: 2

## Mentors
- Gagan Chopra: co-founder of Procolor Film Academy, founder of the media agency All Media (since 2016)
- Durgesh Remje: course director and mentor
